partners.longDescription: A statutory board with a mission to spark and nurture community participation for a caring and united Singapore. PA offers local and overseas undergraduate scholarships to outstanding students who are passionate about community growth and development.

partners.name: Police Intelligence Department (PID)
partners.description: The Police Intelligence Department (PID) is the Singapore Police Force's specialist intelligence unit, responsible for gathering and analysing inte...
partners.longDescription: The Police Intelligence Department (PID) is the Singapore Police Force's specialist intelligence unit, responsible for gathering and analysing intelligence to detect, prevent, and respond to serious security threats.

partners.name: Public Service Division (PSD)
partners.description: The Public Service Commission (PSC) Scholarship is the premier government scholarship awarded to outstanding individuals with strong academic achie...
partners.longDescription: The Public Service Commission (PSC) Scholarship is the premier government scholarship awarded to outstanding individuals with strong academic achievements, character and leadership potential. It offers diverse career pathways across the Public Service for those committed to serving Singapore and Singaporeans.

partners.name: Republic of Singapore Air Force (RSAF)
partners.description: The Republic of Singapore Air Force (RSAF) defends Singapore's airspace and supports national security.
partners.longDescription: The Republic of Singapore Air Force (RSAF) defends Singapore's airspace and supports national security. It offers careers in aviation, engineering, intelligence, cybersecurity, logistics and air operations, providing opportunities to work with advanced technology.

partners.name: Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN)
partners.description: The Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN) defends Singapore's maritime interests and safeguards its sea lines of communication.
partners.longDescription: The Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN) defends Singapore's maritime interests and safeguards its sea lines of communication. It offers careers in operations, engineering, technology, and maritime security, supporting the nation's defence and regional stability.

partners.name: SAF Volunteer Corps (SAFVC)
partners.description: The SAF Volunteer Corps (SAFVC) enables Singaporeans and Permanent Residents to contribute to national defence without full-time military service.
partners.longDescription: The SAF Volunteer Corps (SAFVC) enables Singaporeans and Permanent Residents to contribute to national defence without full-time military service. SAFVC volunteers serve in operational, specialist, and community roles, supporting the Singapore Armed Forces while strengthening Singapore's Total Defence efforts.

partners.name: Scholarship Guide
partners.description: Scholarship Guide is a resource for students planning post-A-Level, IB or diploma studies.
partners.longDescription: Scholarship Guide is a resource for students planning post-A-Level, IB or diploma studies. It publishes an annual magazine and maintains Singapore’s largest scholarship database with over 300 scholarships from 100+ providers, alongside webinars and school fair participation to support students in their scholarship journey.

partners.name: Security and Intelligence Division (SID)
partners.description: The Security and Intelligence Division (SID), under the Prime Minister's Office (PMO), is Singapore's external intelligence agency responsible for ...
partners.longDescription: The Security and Intelligence Division (SID), under the Prime Minister's Office (PMO), is Singapore's external intelligence agency responsible for safeguarding the nation's security by gathering and analysing intelligence on external threats. It offers careers in intelligence analysis, technology, cybersecurity, research and operations.

partners.name: Singapore Airlines (SIA)
partners.description: Singapore’s national carrier and a globally recognised airline known for service excellence.
partners.longDescription: Singapore’s national carrier and a globally recognised airline known for service excellence. Visit the SIA booth to learn more about scholarship opportunities and the diverse career pathways available within the SIA Group. Discover the benefits of being part of a world-class airline and find out what it takes to become an SIA Scholar.

partners.name: Singapore Army
partners.description: The Singapore Army protects Singapore on land and forms the backbone of the Singapore Armed Forces (SAF).
partners.longDescription: The Singapore Army protects Singapore on land and forms the backbone of the Singapore Armed Forces (SAF). It offers careers in combat, engineering, intelligence, logistics, communications and leadership, preparing personnel to defend the nation and respond to security challenges.

partners.name: Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF)
partners.description: The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) is Singapore's national emergency response agency, providing firefighting, rescue, and emergency medical s...
partners.longDescription: The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) is Singapore's national emergency response agency, providing firefighting, rescue, and emergency medical services. SCDF also strengthens community resilience through public education, emergency preparedness, and disaster response.

partners.name: Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT)
partners.description: Nestled in a new centralised campus in the Punggol Digital District, SIT is Singapore’s first university of applied learning, offering industry-rel...
partners.longDescription: Nestled in a new centralised campus in the Punggol Digital District, SIT is Singapore’s first university of applied learning, offering industry-relevant degree programmes that prepare graduates to be future-ready professionals. Through a work-study model and strong industry partnerships, SIT integrates applied learning and research to develop talent and support innovation and economic growth.
partners.moreInfoLink: SIT Admissions Application Toolkit. SIT Scholarship and Financial Aid. SIT Scholars Edition 2025.

partners.name: Singapore Land Authority (SLA)
partners.description: A statutory board under the Ministry of Law and the custodian of Singapore’s State land and properties.
partners.longDescription: A statutory board under the Ministry of Law and the custodian of Singapore’s State land and properties. SLA optimises land use to support the nation’s social and economic development while advancing sustainability through adaptive reuse of properties, green practices, geospatial technology and digitalisation.

partners.name: Singapore Management University (SMU)
partners.description: A premier Asian university known for world-class research and distinguished teaching.
partners.longDescription: A premier Asian university known for world-class research and distinguished teaching. Located in Singapore’s central business district, SMU offers strategic links to business, government and the wider community. It is home to over 12,000 students and a global alumni network of more than 36,000.

partners.name: Singapore Maritime Foundation (SMF)
partners.description: Established in 2004, the Singapore Maritime Foundation (SMF) promotes Singapore as an International Maritime Centre, fosters public-private collabo...
partners.longDescription: Established in 2004, the Singapore Maritime Foundation (SMF) promotes Singapore as an International Maritime Centre, fosters public-private collaboration, and develops maritime talent. It manages the MaritimeONE Scholarship Programme, which has awarded over 700 scholarships worth more than S$19 million to support students pursuing maritime-related diploma and degree courses.

partners.name: Singapore Medical Society of the United Kingdom (SMSUK)
partners.description: A student-led organisation representing Singaporeans studying Medicine and Dentistry in the UK.
partners.longDescription: A student-led organisation representing Singaporeans studying Medicine and Dentistry in the UK. SMSUK serves as a bridge between students and Singapore healthcare organisations, providing insights on applications, student life and career pathways, while facilitating recruitment and information-sharing opportunities.

partners.name: Singapore Police Force (SPF)
partners.description: The Singapore Police Force (SPF) is Singapore's national law enforcement agency responsible for preventing crime, maintaining public order, and ens...
partners.longDescription: The Singapore Police Force (SPF) is Singapore's national law enforcement agency responsible for preventing crime, maintaining public order, and ensuring the safety and security of the community. SPF officers serve in diverse roles, from frontline policing to investigations, counter-terrorism, and community engagement.

partners.name: Singapore Prison Service (SPS)
partners.description: The Singapore Prison Service (SPS) safeguards offenders while supporting their rehabilitation and reintegration into society.
partners.longDescription: The Singapore Prison Service (SPS) safeguards offenders while supporting their rehabilitation and reintegration into society. Through education, skills training, and counselling, SPS helps inmates rebuild their lives and contribute positively to the community.

partners.name: Singapore Psychological Society Youth Wing (SPSYW)
partners.description: The Singapore Psychological Society Youth Wing (SPSYW) is the special branch of the Singapore Psychological Society (SPS), which was founded in 197...
partners.longDescription: The Singapore Psychological Society Youth Wing (SPSYW) is the special branch of the Singapore Psychological Society (SPS), which was founded in 1979 and aims to advance psychology as a science and a profession in Singapore. SPSYW connects students with practitioners, showcases the diverse career pathways within psychology, and promotes the application of psychological knowledge to everyday life through outreach, events and educational initiatives.

partners.name: Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS)
partners.description: SUSS brings together a diverse community ranging from recent JC and polytechnic graduates to working professionals, all united by the goal of using...
partners.longDescription: SUSS brings together a diverse community ranging from recent JC and polytechnic graduates to working professionals, all united by the goal of using education to make a meaningful impact on society. It offers over 110 undergraduate and graduate programmes in flexible full- and part-time modes, as well as modular continuing education and training courses to support lifelong learning and skills upgrading.

partners.name: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
partners.description: A design-focused university that leverages AI to integrate innovation, creativity and technology in solving real-world challenges.
partners.longDescription: A design-focused university that leverages AI to integrate innovation, creativity and technology in solving real-world challenges. Founded in partnership with MIT, SUTD offers a rigorous, industry-relevant curriculum focused on Design Innovation, producing graduates who are highly sought after across industries.

partners.name: Singapore-Industry Scholarship (SgIS)
partners.description: The Singapore-Industry Scholarship (SgIS) is the only multi-industry scholarship in partnership with the Singapore Government.
partners.longDescription: The Singapore-Industry Scholarship (SgIS) is the only multi-industry scholarship in partnership with the Singapore Government. It's designed for Singaporean talent keen to contribute to leading organisations in strategic sectors.

partners.name: SP Group
partners.description: A leading utilities provider in the Asia Pacific, driving the future of energy through low-carbon and smart energy solutions.
partners.longDescription: A leading utilities provider in the Asia Pacific, driving the future of energy through low-carbon and smart energy solutions. As Singapore’s national grid operator, they serve 1.7 million customers and deliver sustainable energy solutions such as renewable energy, EV charging infrastructure, district cooling and heating, and digital energy platforms, across the region.

partners.name: ST Engineering
partners.description: A global technology, defence and engineering group with businesses across aerospace, smart city, defence and public security sectors.
partners.longDescription: A global technology, defence and engineering group with businesses across aerospace, smart city, defence and public security sectors. By harnessing technology and innovation to solve real-world challenges, ST Engineering helps create a more secure and sustainable world, serving customers in over 100 countries.

partners.name: The Second Breakfast Company
partners.description: A not-for-profit theatre company in Singapore founded by young theatre-makers, for young audiences.
partners.longDescription: A not-for-profit theatre company in Singapore founded by young theatre-makers, for young audiences. It aims to cultivate youth engagement in the arts by creating accessible, inclusive theatre that reimagines classics, revives Singapore plays, and develops new writing by emerging artists.
partners.speakerBio:
Leads the company’s artistic vision, directs and performs in productions, and champions emerging talent and new writing alongside works from the Singapore theatre canon.

His work has been presented locally and internationally, including at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. In addition, he is an arts educator, working with students across schools and institutions to support drama education and youth development in Singapore.

His work has been presented locally and internationally, including at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. In addition, he is an arts educator, working with students across schools and institutions to support drama education and youth development in Singapore.

partners.name: Yishun Community Hospital
partners.description: Yishun Community Hospital (YCH) provides rehabilitative, sub-acute and palliative care, supporting patients in their recovery and return to the com...
partners.longDescription: Yishun Community Hospital (YCH) provides rehabilitative, sub-acute and palliative care, supporting patients in their recovery and return to the community. Through a patient-centred approach, YCH works with healthcare and community partners to improve health outcomes and quality of life.
partners.speakerBio: Wei Qing explored various healthcare professions before discovering her passion for Occupational Therapy. Drawn to its versatility and focus on helping individuals lead meaningful lives, she pursued Occupational Therapy at the SIT under a MOHH scholarship. Today, Wei Qing works with patients and their families to promote independence and improve quality of life through assessment, rehabilitation and education.

speakers.name: Wei Qing
speakers.bio: Wei Qing explored various healthcare professions before discovering her passion for Occupational Therapy. Drawn to its versatility and focus on helping individuals lead meaningful lives, she pursued Occupational Therapy at the SIT under a MOHH scholarship. Today, Wei Qing works with patients and their families to promote independence and improve quality of life through assessment, rehabilitation and education.

speakers.name: Shi Ting
speakers.bio: Drawn to healthcare from a young age, Shi Ting discovered her passion for Occupational Therapy through a hospital attachment after graduating from Victoria Junior College (VJC). She pursued the profession at the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT) under the MOHH Healthcare Merit Scholarship. Today, she works with patients to restore independence, enabling them to participate in meaningful activities and improve their quality of life.

speakers.name: Mirza Nabil
speakers.bio: Inspired by the opportunity to support others through life's most challenging moments, Mirza Nabil pursued nursing after his time at VJC and NS in the Singapore Police Force. As a psychiatric nurse, he is passionate about advocating for mental health and providing compassionate care. He also actively contributes to community outreach initiatives, believing that education and service are key to building healthier, more resilient communities.

partners.name: Youth Corps Singapore
partners.description: A national youth development organisation under the National Youth Council that empowers youths aged 15 to 35 to create positive change through com...
partners.longDescription: A national youth development organisation under the National Youth Council that empowers youths aged 15 to 35 to create positive change through community service. Through volunteering, leadership and learning programmes, Youth Corps develops active citizens who champion social causes and contribute to a caring, inclusive and sustainable society.
partners.speakerBio: Jessy wears many hats, but at the heart of her work is helping people learn, grow, and discover what they are capable of. By day, she designs and runs learning experiences for young people, trains aspiring facilitators, and develops programmes that turn ideas into meaningful experiences. Outside of work, she is also a theatre enthusiast who believes that some of life's most important lessons happen beyond the classroom.
